gloss: 依照/根据……。【写作必备句型】

examples.en: According to the newspaper, it's a great movie.
examples.cn: 根据报纸说，这是一部非常棒的电影。

examples.en: According to Chinese custom, 8 is a lucky number.
examples.cn: 根据中国的习俗，8是一个幸运的数字。

gloss: 我可以……吗？【请求允许句型】

examples.en: Am I allowed to smoke here?
examples.cn: 我可以在这儿抽烟吗？

examples.en: Am I allowed to take pictures here?
examples.cn: 我可以在这儿照相吗？

examples.en: Am I allowed to introduce our new manager Mr. Anderson to all of you?
examples.cn: 请允许我向大家介绍我们的新经理安德森先生。

examples.en: As a matter of fact, I don't really agree with you.
examples.cn: 实际上，我不大同意你的看法。

examples.en: As a matter of fact, I just got back from America yesterday.
examples.cn: 事实上，我昨天刚刚从美国回来。

gloss: 就我而言，……【表达观点句型】

examples.en: As far as I'm concerned, everyone should learn English.
examples.cn: 就我看来，大家都应该学英语。

examples.en: As far as I'm concerned, I think we should pay more attention to the safety of schoolchildren.
examples.cn: 就我而言，我认为我们应该更关注在校儿童的安全问题。

examples.en: As far as I know, Teacher Li will come to our school tomorrow.
examples.cn: 据我所知，李老师明天要来我们学校。

examples.en: As far as I know, he is not coming, but I may be wrong.
examples.cn: 就我所知，他不打算来，但我或许会弄错。

examples.en: As I just mentioned, we all need to protect the earth.
examples.cn: 正如我刚才提到过的，我们要保护地球。

examples.en: As I just mentioned, nobody should drop out of school unless they believe they face the opportunity of a lifetime. And even then they should reconsider.
examples.cn: 正如我刚才提到过的，任何人都不应该辍学，除非他们相信他们面临着一生中难得的机会。即使是那样，他们还需再三考虑。

gloss: 在我看来，……【表达观点句型】

examples.en: As I see it, inflation is still growing.
examples.cn: 在我看来，通货膨胀还在继续。

examples.en: As I see it, he is not the right person for this position.
examples.cn: 在我看来，他不是这个职位的适合人选。

pattern: As is known to us all

examples.en: As is known to us all, Hong Kong is one of the financial centers of Asia.
examples.cn: 众所周知，香港是亚洲金融中心之一。

examples.en: As is known to us all, China has the largest population in the world.
examples.cn: 众所周知，中国是世界上人口最多的国家。

gloss: 只要……。【引导条件状语从句的句型】

examples.en: As long as you're going to live here, you should really study Chinese.
examples.cn: 如果你要在这儿住的话，你真应该学中文。

examples.en: As long as we work together, we can make the impossible possible.
examples.cn: 只要我们一起努力，我们就能把不可能变为可能。

gloss: 若不是因为⋯……。/ 如果没有⋯。【虚拟语气句型】

examples.en: But for wearing his seat belt, he would have died in the crash.
examples.cn: 如果不是系了安全带，他就已经死于车祸了。

examples.en: But for your generous help, we couldn't have finished the work so soon.
examples.cn: 如果没有你的鼎力相助，我们不可能这么快完成工作的。

gloss: 你相信……吗？【that引导宾语从句】

examples.en: Can you believe that Yao Ming taught himself English？
examples.cn: 你相信吗，姚明的英语是自学的。

examples.en: Can you believe (that) this excellent song was composed by a high school student?
examples.cn: 你相信这首美妙的歌曲是出自一个高中生之手吗？

examples.en: Can you imagine how much your parents love you?
examples.cn: 你能想像你的父母是多么的爱你吗？

examples.en: Can you imagine how she lived through all these difficulties？
examples.cn: 你能想像她是怎么捱过种种困境的吗？

examples.en: Could you please explain why you didn't come to the meeting yesterday?
examples.cn: 你能解释一下为什么昨天没来开会吗？

examples.en: Could you please explain a little bit more about the Forbidden City?
examples.cn: 你能再多说一点关于紫禁城的事情吗？

gloss: 难道我们不能……吗？【反问句型】

examples.en: Can't we walk there from here?
examples.cn: 我们就不能从这儿走到那儿吗？

examples.en: Can't we just finish the work tomorrow?
examples.cn: 难道我们就不能明天再完成这项工作吗？

pattern: Could you do me a favor and...?

examples.en: Could you do me a favor and lend me 10 dollars until tomorrow?
examples.cn: 能否帮我个忙，借我10美元？明天还你。

examples.en: Could you do me a favor and give this present to Hilary for her birthday?
examples.cn: 能否帮我一个忙，把这份生日礼物交给希拉里？

pattern: Do you by any chance know...？

examples.en: Do you by any chance know what time the movie begins？
examples.cn: 你知道电影什么时候开始吗？

examples.en: Do you by any chance know if this machine accepts foreign bank cards?
examples.cn: 你知道这台机器可以刷外国银行卡吗？【绝对高级！】

gloss: 你喜欢……吗？【询问爱好句型】

examples.en: Do you enjoy trying different kinds of food?
examples.cn: 你喜欢尝试不同的食物吗？

examples.en: Do you enjoy having a few friends around talking and laughing？
examples.cn: 你喜欢几个朋友聚在一起有说有笑吗？

examples.en: Do you happen to know how I can get to Times Square？
examples.cn: 你知道怎么去时代广场吗？

examples.en: Do you happen to know a good Beijing duck restaurant around here?
examples.cn: 你知道这儿附近有不错的北京烤鸭店吗？

pattern: Do you have any good ways to...?

examples.en: Do you have any good ways to improve pronunciation?
examples.cn: 你有没有改善发音的好办法？

examples.en: Do you have any good ways to promote our new product？
examples.cn: 你有没有好办法推广我们的新产品？

gloss: 你知道⋯……吗？【that引导宾语从句】

examples.en: Did you know (that)we are getting a foreign teacher this semester?
examples.cn: 你知道吗，我们这学期将有一个外教。

examples.en: Did you know (that) Daniel won the first prize of the writing contest?
examples.cn: 你知道吗，丹尼尔在写作比赛中拿了一等奖。

examples.en: Do you know if there are any apartments available in this area?
examples.cn: 你知不知道这一带有没有公寓出租？

examples.en: Do you know if there is an English corner this weekend？
examples.cn: 你知不知道这个周末有没有英语角？

examples.en: Would you mind giving me a glass of water and some aspirin?
examples.cn: 你能不能给我一杯水和一些阿司匹林？

examples.en: Do you mind speaking a little more slowly?
examples.cn: 你可以说得稍微慢一点吗？

examples.en: Do you mind if I ask you a few questions?
examples.cn: 你介意我问你几个问题吗？

examples.en: Would you mind if we took a picture together?
examples.cn: 我们一起拍张照吧？【绝对高级、礼貌！】

examples.en: Do you realize that everyone is counting on you?
examples.cn: 你有没有意识到，大家都指望你了？

examples.en: Do you realize (that) your parents really care about you？
examples.cn: 你有没有意识到，你的父母很关心你？

pattern: Do you think it is possible to...？

examples.en: Do you think it is possible to solve the problem overnight?
examples.cn: 一夜之间解决这个问题你觉得有可能吗？

examples.en: Do you think it is possible for you to watch my kids? I have to go to the bathroom.
examples.cn: 可以帮我照看一下孩子吗？我去一下洗手问。

pattern: Do you think it necessary to...？

examples.en: Do you think it necessary to ask for official permission for the event to take place?
examples.cn: 你觉得进行这项活动，有必要得到正式的批准吗？

examples.en: Do you think it necessary to take an umbrella?
examples.cn: 你觉得有必要带把伞吗？

examples.en: What you said doesn't make sense. I don't agree with you.
examples.cn: 你说的话没有道理。我不同意你的看法。

examples.en: This bill doesn' make sense. I was overcharged.
examples.cn: 账单不对，多收我钱了。

examples.en: Don' be afraid of losing face and making mistakes.
examples.cn: 不要害怕丢脸和犯错。【李阳疯狂英语经典口号】

examples.en: Don't be afraid of talking with foreigners.
examples.cn: 不要害怕和外国人说话。

pattern: Don't take it for granted that

examples.en: Don't take it for granted that there will always be enough water for mankind.
examples.cn: 别理所当然认为人类总会有足够的水可用。

examples.en: Don't take it for granted that your parents should support you all your life.
examples.cn: 别以 你父母养你一辈子是天经地义的事。

examples.en: Don't waste time playing video games.
examples.cn: 不要浪费时间玩电子游戏。

examples.en: Don't waste time learning a lot of useless words in isolation. The best way of learning English words 1s to blurt out as many authentic sentences as you can.
examples.cn: 不要浪费时间孤立地学习没有用的单词。学习英语单词最好的方法就是脱口而出尽量多的地道句子。

examples.en: Don't you think that the gap between rich and poor is getting wider?
examples.cn: 难道你不认为贫富差距越来越大了吗？

examples.en: Don't you think that his English sounds just like a native speaker？
examples.cn: 你不觉得他的英语听起来像是本土人说的吗？【绝对高级、纯正！】

examples.en: Excuse me for interrupting, but I have something urgent to say.
examples.cn: 很抱歉打断你，但我有急事要说。【urgent n. 紧急的；急迫的】

examples.en: Excuse me for making this phone call, but it is very important.
examples.cn: 很抱歉给你打这个电话，但是我有重要的事情要说。

examples.en: For one thing, these shoes don't suit you. For another, they are too expensive.
examples.cn: 一方面，这双鞋子并不适合你；另一方面，这太贵了。

examples.en: For one thing, it is too far away. For another, it is too crowded on the weekend. Wed better stay home.
examples.cn: 一方面，太远了；另一方面，周末人太挤了。我们还是待在家里吧。

examples.en: From my point of view, Crazy English is the most 【
examples.cn: 表达观点句型】 effective way to learn English.在我看来，“疯狂英语”是学习英语最有效的方法。

examples.en: From my point of view, America is China's most important strategic partner.
examples.cn: 在我看来，美国是中国最重要的战略伙伴。

examples.en: From where I stand, we should stand by him no matter what happens.
examples.cn: 依我看来，无论发生什么事，我们都应该支持他。

examples.en: From where I stand, pollution is the biggest Challenge we face.
examples.cn: 依我看，污染是我们面临的最大挑战。

examples.en: Generally speaking, Chinese students are very shy.
examples.cn: 总的来说，中国学生很腼腆。

examples.en: Generally speaking people like to hear compliments from others.
examples.cn: 总的说来，人们都喜欢听到别人的称赞。

examples.en: Hardly had she begun speaking when there was a knock on the door.
examples.cn: 她刚开始说话就听见敲门声。

examples.en: Hardly had we arrived when the movie started.
examples.cn: 我们刚到电影就开始放了。

examples.en: Have you considered going abroad to study?
examples.cn: 你有没有考虑过出国留学？

examples.en: Have you considered starting your own business?
examples.cn: 你有没有考虑过自己做生意？

examples.en: Have you decided on a major?
examples.cn: 你决定好要学什么专业了吗？

examples.en: Have you decided where to spend your summer Vacation？
examples.cn: 你决定好去哪儿过暑假了吗？

examples.en: Have you ever been to Disneyland?
examples.cn: 你有没有去过迪斯尼乐园？

examples.en: Have you ever been to any rural parts of China?
examples.cn: 你去过中国农村地区吗？

examples.en: Have you thought of becoming an English teacher?
examples.cn: 你想过做英语老师吗？

examples.en: Have you thought about setting up your own business？
examples.cn: 你想过自己做生意吗？

examples.en: Haven't you heard of Crazy English established by Li Yang？
examples.cn: 难道你没听说过李阳创立的疯狂英语吗？

examples.en: Haven't you heard of Liu Xiang? He is a very famous athlete in China.
examples.cn: 你没听说刘翔吗？他是中国非常著名的运动员。

pattern: How are you getting on/along with...?

examples.en: How are you getting on with swimming lessons?
examples.cn: 你的游泳课进展如何？

examples.en: How are you getting along with your business?
examples.cn: 你的生意做得如何？

gloss: 你打算如何……？【询问打算句型】

examples.en: How are you going to celebrate your graduation?
examples.cn: 你打算如何庆祝你毕业了？

examples.en: How are you going to prepare for the speech competition？
examples.cn: 你打算怎么准备演讲比赛？

examples.en: How does making our appointment at 8sound?
examples.cn: 我们把约会定在8点如何？

examples.en: How does taking a break and getting a drink sound?
examples.cn: 休息一下，喝一杯怎么样？

pattern: How long will/does it take you to...?

examples.en: How long will it take you to memorize your speech?
examples.cn: 你记住演讲稿得花多长时间？

examples.en: How long does it take you to walk home from your office?
examples.cn: 你从办公室走到家得花多长时间？

examples.en: How long will it take you to recite such a passage?
examples.cn: 你背诵这么一篇文章要多长时间？

gloss: 我该如何…...？【征求建议句型】

examples.en: How should I tell him the bad news?
examples.cn: 我该如何告诉他这个坏消息？

examples.en: How should I contact you？
examples.cn: 我怎么跟你联系呢？

gloss: 我完全同意………。【表达同意句型】

examples.en: Sure, I absolutely agree with your point.
examples.cn: 当然，我绝对同意你的观点。

examples.en: I absolutely agree with this article; you should read it.
examples.cn: 我完全赞同这篇文章的观点，你应该看看。

gloss: 我非常感激【表达感激句型】

examples.en: I'm grateful for your timely help.
examples.cn: 非常感谢你及时的帮助。

examples.en: I'm grateful for everything my parents have done for me.
examples.cn: 我非常感谢我的父母为我做的一切。

examples.en: I am planning to travel around China.
examples.cn: 我打算游遍中国。

examples.en: I am planning to attend LYCE intensive training camp this summer.
examples.cn: 今年夏天我打算参加李阳疯狂英语集训营。【绝对地道！】第二级

pattern: I am very pleased to have this opportunity to

examples.en: I am very pleased to have this opportunity to stand here and give you a speech.
examples.cn: 我很高兴有机会站在这里为你们作演讲。

examples.en: I am very pleased to have this opportunity to show you around Beijing.
examples.cn: 我很高兴有机会带你逛北京。

examples.en: I apologize for leaving you alone.
examples.cn: 很抱歉把你一个人留下。

examples.en: I apologize for keeping you waiting.
examples.cn: 很抱歉让你久等了。

examples.en: I believe that we can cure cancer totally some day.
examples.cn: 我相信我们总有一天能够完全治愈癌症。

examples.en: I believe that everyone should learn a foreign language.
examples.cn: 我相信每个人都应该学一门外语。

gloss: 我认为我们应该…。【表达观点何型】

examples.en: I believe we should work together to protect OuT environment.
examples.cn: 我认为我们应该携手保护环境。

examples.en: I believe we should have a great aim in our life.
examples.cn: 我认为我们人生要有远大的目标。

examples.en: I can't imagine what my life would be like if I were disabled.
examples.cn: 我无法想像如果我身惠残疾，我的生活会怎样。

examples.en: I can't imagine how cold it must be here in the winter.
examples.cn: 我无法想像这里冬天会有多冷。

gloss: 我无法忍受……。【经典抱怨句型】

examples.en: I can't stand it when I forget how to say something in English.
examples.cn: 有些话忘了用英语怎么说让我受不了。

examples.en: I can't stand it when people talk with their mouth full.
examples.cn: 我无法忍受别人说话的时候满嘴食物。

gloss: 我没想到…⋯。【表达意外的句型】

examples.en: I didn't expect to see you here.
examples.cn: 真没想到会在这里见到你。

examples.en: I didn't expect to receive such a pretty card from him.
examples.cn: 我没想到能收到他寄来的那么漂亮的卡片。

examples.en: I didn't mean to offend you.
examples.cn: 我不是有意要冒犯你的。【offend v. 冒犯：得罪】

examples.en: I didn't mean to keep you waiting for such a long time, I'm sorry.
examples.cn: 我不是有意让你等这么久的，对不起。

examples.en: 1didnt realize how much this meant to you.
examples.cn: 我不知道这对你那么重要。

examples.en: I didn't realize you spoke Chinese.
examples.cn: 我不知道你会说中文。

examples.en: I feel like going rock climbing with you this weekend.
examples.cn: 这周末我想和你一起去攀岩。

examples.en: I really don't feel like going to the movies tonight.
examples.cn: 我今晚真的不想去看电影。

pattern: I don't get very excited about

examples.en: I don't get very excited about going to concerts.
examples.cn: 我对去听演唱会不怎么感兴趣。

examples.en: I don't get very excited about math class.
examples.cn: 我不怎么喜欢数学课。

examples.en: I don't know how to answer the question.
examples.cn: 我不知道如何回答这个问题。

examples.en: I don't know how to say what I mean in English.
examples.cn: 我不知道如何用英语表达自己的意思。

examples.en: I don't see that she really intends to help us out.
examples.cn: 我觉得她无意于帮助我们。

examples.en: I don't see (that) anyone has a problem with our Plan.
examples.cn: 我看不出谁对我们的计划有意见。

pattern: I don't think it is necessary to

examples.en: I don't think it is necessary to leave so early.
examples.cn: 我认为没有必要这么早走。

examples.en: I don't think it is necessary to order so much food.
examples.cn: 我觉得没必要点这么多吃的。

pattern: I don't think it's right to

examples.en: don't think it's right to bad-mouth other people.
examples.cn: 我认为说别人坏话是不对的。【bad-mouth .说.…⋯•坏话】

examples.en: I don't think it is right to use so many plastic bags.
examples.cn: 我觉得用这么多塑料袋是不对的。

examples.en: I doubt if what he said is true.
examples.cn: 我怀疑他所说的不是事实。

examples.en: I doubt if she has ever been to Hong Kong.
examples.cn: 我怀疑她是不是去过香港。

examples.en: I dream of being a successful salesman.
examples.cn: 我梦想成为一名成功的推销员。

examples.en: I dream of speaking English as well as Li Yang.
examples.cn: 我梦想英语说得和李阳一样好。

gloss: 我渴望….⋯/我盼望……【表达渴望句型】

examples.en: I'm dying to improve my English.
examples.cn: 我渴望提高自己的英语水平。

examples.en: I'm dying to leave for Beijing to meet my parents.
examples.cn: 我盼望着前往北京去见我的父母。

gloss: 我觉得很荣幸…。【经典演讲句型】

examples.en: I feel very honored to speak to you today.
examples.cn: 我很荣幸今天能在此给你们讲话。

examples.en: I feel very honored to be a member of this team.
examples.cn: 能成为这个队的一员我深感荣幸。

examples.en: I'm fed up with his complaining.
examples.cn: 我受够了他的抱怨。

examples.en: I'm fed up with all these traffic jams.
examples.cn: 我受够了这些交通堵塞。

gloss: 我对…感到厌烦。【经奥抱怨句型】

examples.en: I'm sick and tired of all this noise.
I'm sick and tired of the same old routine every
examples.cn: 这些噪音让我烦透了 day. 我对日复一日呆板的生活感到厌倦。 【routine n. 日常事物：常规】第 6 张照片

pattern: I find it hard for me to

examples.en: I find it hard for me to study late at night.
examples.cn: 我发现熬夜学习对我来说很难。

examples.en: I find it hard for me to make a speech in public.
examples.cn: 我发现在公众场合作演讲对我来说很难。

pattern: I hate to disagree with you, but

examples.en: I hate to disagree with you, but what you are saying isn't correct.
examples.cn: 我不想跟你有不同意见，但你说的不对。

examples.en: I hate to disagree with you, but I think your view is impractical.
examples.cn: 我不想跟你有不同意见，但我认为你的观点不切合实际。

examples.en: I have confidence in winning the Crazy English Speech contest.
examples.cn: 我有信心赢得这次疯狂英语演讲比赛。

examples.en: I have confidence in making it into a top university.
examples.cn: 我有信心能考入一所重点大学。

pattern: I have nothing to do with

examples.en: I have nothing to do with that man; I've never seen him before.
examples.cn: 我与那个人一点关系都没有，我以前从来没见过他。

examples.en: I have nothing to do with that problem - I just arrived.
examples.cn: 这个问题跟我一点关系都没有，我刚刚才到的。

examples.en: I have no experience in dealing with children.
examples.cn: 我在和孩子打交道方面没有什么经验。

examples.en: I have no experience in talking with native speakers.
examples.cn: 我还没有和英语为母语的人交谈过。

pattern: I haven't done... for a long time

examples.en: I haven't played the piano for a long time.
examples.cn: 我很久没有弹钢琴了。

examples.en: I haven't spoken English for a long time.
examples.cn: 我好久没说英语了。

gloss: 我坚决要求……。【宾语从句使用虚拟语气】

examples.en: I insist that you let me show you around.
examples.cn: 我坚持要求你让我带你到处转转。

examples.en: I insist that you give me my money back.
examples.cn: 我坚持要求你把钱退给我。

gloss: 我坚持……。【后接V-ing形式作宾语】

examples.en: I insisted on making him our coach.
examples.cn: 我坚持要他做我们的教练。

examples.en: I insisted on paying for lunch.
examples.cn: 我坚持午餐由我付账。

examples.en: I intend to give him a surprise.
examples.cn: 我打算给他一个惊喜。

examples.en: I intend to study in America next year.
examples.cn: 我打算明年去美国读书。

examples.en: I like nothing better than helping people.
examples.cn: 我最喜欢帮助别人。

examples.en: I like nothing better than traveling to places I've never been to before.
examples.cn: 我最喜欢去从来没有去过的地方旅行。

gloss: 我从未想过……【表达意外旬型】

examples.en: I never dreamed of getting a perfect score.
examples.cn: 我从未想过拿这么高的分。

examples.en: I never dreamed of meeting you here. What a coincidence！

gloss: 我喜欢…⋯胜过……。【表达偏爱句型】

examples.en: I prefer playing sports to watching them on TV.
examples.cn: 我喜欢玩体育运动胜过在电视上看体育比赛。

examples.en: I prefer working as a manager in a small company to working as a clerk in a big one.
examples.cn: 我喜欢在小公司当经理胜过在大公司做小职员。

examples.en: I prefer to send text messages rather than call.
examples.cn: 我宁愿发短信而不愿打电话。

examples.en: I prefer to stay at home rather than go out.
examples.cn: 我宁愿呆在家里而不愿出去。

examples.en: I really want to know more about your country.
examples.cn: 我真的想多了解你的国家。

examples.en: I really want to know how to improve my English Pronunciation.
examples.cn: 我真的很想知道如何改进我的英语发音。

pattern: I set my mind to do sth./on sth

examples.en: I set my mind on winning the competition.
examples.cn: 我下定决心要赢得比赛。

examples.en: I set my mind to believe, hope, and endure all things.
examples.cn: 我下定决心对所有事情采取信任、希望和容忍的态度。

gloss: 我真诚地希望…⋯。【表达希望句型】

examples.en: I sincerely hope that our friendship will last forever.
examples.cn: 我真诚地希望我们的友谊天长地久。

examples.en: I sincerely hope that you will take China as your second home.
examples.cn: 我真诚地希望你能把中国当作你的第二故乡。

gloss: 我强烈建议你…⋯。【不定式作宾补】

examples.en: I strongly advise you to drink more water.
examples.cn: 我强烈建议你多喝水。

examples.en: I strongly advise you to attend Crazy English Summer Camp, and I'm sure you will get more than you expected.
examples.cn: 我强烈建议你参加疯狂英语夏令营，我相信你会学到比你预期的还要多。

gloss: 我建议……【宾语从句使用虚拟语气】

examples.en: I suggest (that) yougo there by yourself.
examples.cn: 我建议你自己一个人去那里。

examples.en: I suggest (that) you try some special local foods.
examples.cn: 我建议你尝尝一些当地特色食品。

pattern: I think this is a good chance for you to

examples.en: I think this is a good chance for you to test your English.
examples.cn: 我认为这是测试你英语水平的好机会。

examples.en: I think this is a good chance for you to make new friends.
examples.cn: 我认为这是你交新朋友的好机会。

pattern: I think it is a good idea to

examples.en: I think it is a good idea to do exercise every day.
examples.cn: 我认为每天做运动是个好主意。

examples.en: I think it is a good idea to save all receipts.
examples.cn: 我认为把所有的收据都收好是个好主意。

pattern: I think it is a waste of money/time doing

examples.en: I think it is a waste of time sitting in front of the television all day.
examples.cn: 我觉得整天看电视是浪费时间。

examples.en: I think it is a waste of time memorizing words and grammar rules.
examples.cn: 我觉得背单词和语法规则很浪费时间。

gloss: 我认为…是不对的。【表达看法句型】

examples.en: I think it's wrong to impose your thoughts on others.
examples.cn: 我认为把自己的想法强加给别人是不对的。

examples.en: I think it's wrong to treat service people rudely.
examples.cn: 我认为粗鲁对待服务人员是不对的。

pattern: I think that it is impossible to

examples.en: I think that it is impossible to be there before eight.
examples.cn: 我觉得在8点之前赶到那里是不可能的。

examples.en: I think that it is impossible to see everything on such a short trip.
examples.cn: 我觉得在这么短的旅程中要看到所有的东西是不可能的。

pattern: I think you might like to

examples.en: I think you might like to know something about my hometown.
examples.cn: 我想你可能会想知道一些关于我家乡的事情。

examples.en: I think you might like to hear the legend of this dish.
examples.cn: 我想你可能会想知道关于这道菜的由来。

gloss: 我觉得你最好………。【表达建议句型】

examples.en: I think youd better rest for a while.
examples.cn: 我觉得你最好休息一下。

examples.en: I think youd better hurry up, or you will be late.
examples.cn: 我觉得你最好快点，不然要迟到了。

pattern: I want to express my gratitude to

examples.en: I want to express my gratitude to my family for their support.
examples.cn: 我要感谢我的家人给我的支持。

examples.en: I want to express my gratitude to my teacher for her guidance and patience.
examples.cn: 我要感谢我的老师对我的耐心指导。

examples.en: I was impressed by his inspiring words, and I decided to cooperate with him.
examples.cn: 他令人鼓舞的话打动了我，我决定跟他合作。

examples.en: I was deeply impressed by the athletes' dedication.
examples.cn: 运动员们的执着深深地打动了我。

examples.en: I wonder if I could take this dictionary home.
examples.cn: 我想知道能否把这本字典带回家。

examples.en: I was wondering if you'd like to go to a concert tomorrow night.
examples.cn: 我在想你明天晚上是否愿意去听演唱会。

examples.en: I demanded (that) I see the principal right away.
examples.cn: 我要求马上见校长。

examples.en: I demanded (that) he pick up the litter he had thrown on the ground.
examples.cn: 我要求他把自己扔在地上的垃圾捡起来。

examples.en: I won't write to him unless he writes to me first.
I won't leave unless you give me a reason.
examples.cn: 除非你给我一个理由，否则我是不会走的。

examples.en: I used to go to play basketball with some of my friends every Saturday afteroon.
examples.cn: 以前每个星期六我都和一些朋友去打篮球。

examples.en: I used to be afraid of speaking English.
examples.cn: 我曾经害怕说英语。

examples.en: I would advise you to book tickets in advance.
examples.cn: 我建议你还是提前订票吧。

examples.en: I would advise you to get up earlier on Mondays， because there's always a traffic jam.
examples.cn: 我想建议你星期一早上早点起床，因为星期一总是会塞车。

examples.en: I would appreciate it if you call me back this evening.
examples.cn: 如果你晚上再打过来，我会非常感激。

examples.en: I would appreciate it if you would write a few words for me.
examples.cn: 如果你给我写点什么的话，我会非常感激。

gloss: 我想推荐……。【推荐介绍句型】

examples.en: I would like to recommend the noodles here.
1would like to recommend a trip to Jiuzhaigou.
examples.cn: 我想推荐去九寨沟旅行。

examples.en: I would like to take a walk rather than watch TV this weekend.
examples.cn: 周末我宁愿散步也不想看电视。

examples.en: I would like to chat in person rather than chat on line.
examples.cn: 我宁愿面对面聊天而不是网上聊天。

examples.en: I would rather eat local food than fast food.
examples.cn: 我想吃本地的食品而不是快餐。

examples.en: I would rather stay at home than go shopping on such a humid day.
examples.cn: 这么潮湿的天，我宁愿呆在家里也不愿意去购物。

examples.en: I wouldn't feel happy if you didn't come to my birthday party.
examples.cn: 如果你不来我的生日聚会，我会不高兴的。

examples.en: 1wouldn't feel happy if I felt you weren't comfortable.
examples.cn: 如果感觉你不舒服的话，我会不高兴的。

pattern: I'd be happy to...， if you'd like

examples.en: I'd be happy to show you around, if you'd like.
examples.cn: 如果你愿意，我很高兴带你四处看看。

examples.en: I'd be happy to translate for you, if you'd like.
examples.cn: 如果你愿意，我很高兴给你翻译。

pattern: I'd like to know more about

examples.en: I'd like to know more about the project you are carrying out.
examples.cn: 我想更多地了解你们正在进行的项目。

examples.en: I'd like to know more about how you learned English.
examples.cn: 我想更多地了解你是怎样学英语的。

pattern: I'd like to suggest you do

examples.en: I'd like to suggest you take the test When you are still in school..
examples.cn: 我想建议你还在上学的时候就参加这个考试。

examples.en: I'd like to suggest you visit our school again soon.
examples.cn: 我想建议你不久之后再来我们学校参观。

gloss: 我很想，但……。【表达拒绝句型】

examples.en: I'd love to, but I'm afraid I'm otherwise engaged.
examples.cn: 我很想，但恐怕我已经另有安排了。

examples.en: I'd love to, but sadly, I am leaving tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我很想，但是很遗憾，我明天就要走了。

examples.en: I'm certain that you will get over your laziness.
examples.cn: 我确信你会克服你的惰性的。

examples.en: I'm not certain whether this address is correct.
examples.cn: 我不确定这个地址对不对。

pattern: I'm afraid I won't be able to

examples.en: I'm afraid I won't be able to finish the task before Friday.
examples.cn: 恐怕我无法在星期五之前完成这项任务。

examples.en: I'm afraid I won't be able to keep our appointment.
examples.cn: 恐怕我无法赴约了。

examples.en: Don't bother me -I'm busy with my project right now.
examples.cn: 别打扰我，我现在正忙我的项目呢。

examples.en: Don't bother me -I am busy writing my composition.
examples.cn: 别烦我，我在忙着写作文呢。

examples.en: I'm considering buying a second-hand computer because I'm short of money now.
examples.cn: 因为现在钱不够，我正考虑买台二手电脑。

examples.en: I'm considering paying a visit to Bejing next month.
examples.cn: 我正考虑下个月去北京玩。

examples.en: I'm convinced that what you said is quite right.
examples.cn: 我相信你所说的相当正确。

examples.en: I'm convinced that our school has the best teachers.
examples.cn: 我相信，我们的学校有最好的老师。

examples.en: I'm curious to know what was happening outside.
examples.cn: 我很好奇想知道刚才外面发生了什么事。

examples.en: I'm curious to know more about American holidays.
examples.cn: 我很好奇想多了解一些关于美国节日的情况。

examples.en: I'm determined to read 10 books this month.
examples.cn: 我决定这个月读十本书

examples.en: I'm determined to practice English every morning when I wake up.
examples.cn: 我决定每天早上一起床就操练英语。

pattern: I'm getting a little concerned about

examples.en: I'm getting a little concerned about my father's health.
examples.cn: 我对我父亲的健康状况有点担忧。

examples.en: I'm getting a little concerned about the results of my TOEFL test.
examples.cn: 我对我的托福考试成绩有点担忧。

gloss: 我对…⋯感兴趣。【表达兴趣句型】

examples.en: I'm interested in joining the English corner.
examples.cn: 我有感兴趣参加英语角。

examples.en: I'm interested in learning more about your country.
examples.cn: 我很有兴趣多点了解你的国家。

gloss: 我打电话来是要……。【打电话常用句型】

examples.en: I am just calling to confirm my flight number.
examples.cn: 我打电话来是要确认我的航班号。

examples.en: I am (just) calling to see how you are feeling.
examples.cn: 我打电话来是想看看你现在感觉如何。

examples.en: I'm not sure if I should accept that job offer in Hong Kong.
examples.cn: 我不确定我是否应该接受香港的那份工作。

examples.en: I'm not sure if I want to go abroad to study.
examples.cn: 我不确定我是否想出国留学。

examples.en: I'm not very interested in Korean TV shows.
examples.cn: 我对韩剧不是很感兴趣。

examples.en: I'm not very interested in listening to classical music.
examples.cn: 我对听古典音乐不是很感兴趣。

examples.en: I'm occupied in preparing for the final exams; don't bother me！
I'm occupied with volunteer work. I'm an Olympic volunteer.
examples.cn: 我正忙着做志愿工作，我是奥运会志愿者。

gloss: 我很喜欢…⋯。【表达爱好句型】

examples.en: I'm really fond of surfing the Internet; it is pretty convenient.
examples.cn: 我很喜欢上网，上网真的很方便。

examples.en: I'm really fond of classical music because it can calm me down.
examples.cn: 我很喜欢古典音乐，因为它可以让我平静。

examples.en: I'm really sorry for the delay of the report.
examples.cn: 报告延误上交，我对此感到非常抱歉。

examples.en: I'm really sorry for what happened.
examples.cn: 我对刚刚发生的事情感到非常抱歉。

examples.en: I've been thinking about going to France to study art.
examples.cn: 我一直想去法国学艺术。

examples.en: I've been thinking about going to your intensive training camp.
examples.cn: 我一直想参加你的集训营。

gloss: 我非常渴望⋯……。【表达渴望句型】

examples.en: I have a strong desire to speak good English.
examples.cn: 我非常渴望说一口流利的英语。

examples.en: I have a desire to hike the Great Wall.
examples.cn: 我渴望去长城徒步。

gloss: 我已经决定……【表达决定句型】

examples.en: I've decided to join a health club.
examples.cn: 我已经决定加入一个健康俱乐部。

examples.en: I've decided to run for the monitor of our class.
examples.cn: 我已经决定竞选班长了。【run for：竞选】

examples.en: If I knew his number, I would phone him.
examples.cn: 如果我知道他的电话号码，我会打电话给他的。

examples.en: If I had enough money, I would buy an MP3 player.
examples.cn: 如果我带够钱，我会买一部MIP3。

examples.en: If I had known that you were coming, I would
examples.cn: 如果我……，我就会…⋯。 have met you at the airport.如果我知道你要来，我就去机场接你了。

examples.en: If I had seen the accident, I would have stopped to help.
examples.cn: 如果我看到了事故，我就停下来帮忙了。

pattern: If I were you, I would

examples.en: If I were you, I would get rid of this bad habit.
If I were you, I would take a bottle of water with me.
examples.cn: 如果我是你，我就会改掉这个坏习惯。

gloss: 真希望……/若是…那该多好啊。

examples.en: If only she would accept my invitation.
examples.cn: 要是她接受我的邀请该多好啊！

examples.en: If only we could get a ticket！
If it is possible, I'd like to visit your company.
examples.cn: 如果可能的话，我想参观你的公司。

examples.en: If it is possible, lend me your car tonight.
examples.cn: 如果可能的话，今晚把你的车借给我。

pattern: If you ask me, I think

examples.en: If you ask me, I think you should practice more.
examples.cn: 如果你问我，我认为你应该多加练习。

examples.en: If you ask me, I think pollution is China's biggest problem.
examples.cn: 如果你问我，我认为污染是中国最大的问题。

pattern: If you want to...， you'll have to

examples.en: If you want to remember more words, you'll have to read a lot in English.
examples.cn: 你要是想记住更多的单词，你就得读大量的英语。

examples.en: If you want to lose weight, you'll have to eat less and exercise more.
examples.cn: 如果你想减肥，你就得少吃多运动。

examples.en: In a word, money is something but not everything.
examples.cn: 总之，金钱很重要，但不是万能的。

examples.en: What matters most in life? In a word, health.
examples.cn: 生命中什么最重要？一句话，健康。

examples.en: In brief, we cannot please everyone all the time.
examples.cn: 总而言之，我们无法总是让每个人都满意。

examples.en: In short, science frees us from the bondage of nature. It has made our lives easier and more comfortable.
examples.cn: 总之，科学把我们从自然的束缚中解脱出来，使我们生活得更加轻松舒适。【bondage n. 束缚：奴役】

gloss: 最后，……。/总之，……。【经典概括句型】

examples.en: In conclusion, I find mutual understanding plays a key role in building a friendly relationship.
examples.cn: 总之，我发现相互理解对建立友好关系至关重要。

examples.en: In conclusion, we must work together to improve Our performance.
examples.cn: 总之，我们必须合作才能提高成绩。

gloss: 一般而言，…⋯。【经典写作句型】

examples.en: In general, graduates who speak good English will have more chances than those who don t.
examples.cn: 机会更多。

examples.en: In general, the food here is very light and fresh.
examples.cn: 一般来说，这里的食物很清淡。

examples.en: In my opinion, we should never abandon hope for success.
examples.cn: 我认为我们永还不应该没弃对成功的希望。

examples.en: In my opinion, exams create a lot of stress.
examples.cn: 我认为，考试带来了很多压力。

examples.en: In order to understand this essay fully, you should read more about its author.
examples.cn: 为了更充分地理解这篇文章，你应该再看一些关于作者的介绍。

examples.en: In order to score well in exams, you should study every day and not wait until the last minute.
examples.cn: 为了考试拿高分，你应该每天学习，不要临时抱佛脚。

examples.en: In other words, you should read and speak English crazily every day.
examples.cn: 换句话说，你应该每天疯狂读英语、说英语。

examples.en: In other words, there are no shortcuts to success.
examples.cn: 换句话说，成功是没有捷径的。

examples.en: In that case, I have no more to say.
examples.cn: 那样的话，我没有什么好说的了。

examples.en: The weather forecast calls for rain tomorrow. In that case, we will meet indoors.
examples.cn: 天气预报说明天会下雨。这样的话，我们就在室内会面吧。

examples.en: If you want to succeed in life, I think to set a goal for yourself is of great importance.
examples.cn: 如果你想在生活中成功，我觉得为自己确立一个目标是非常重要的。

examples.en: Communication skills are of great importance in today's job market.
examples.cn: 在今天的就业市场，沟通能力至关重要。

pattern: Is it convenient for you to...？

examples.en: Is it convenient for you to post this letter for me When you go out?
examples.cn: 你出去的时候是否方便帮我把这封信寄了？

examples.en: Is it convenient for you to read my essay this afternoon？
examples.cn: 今天下午你方便读一下我的文章吗？

examples.en: Is it OK if Iborrow your notebook tonight?
examples.cn: 我今晚借你的笔记本可以吗？

examples.en: Is it OK if Iask you a few questions?
examples.cn: 我可以问你几个问题吗？

examples.en: Isi possible to exchange the milk Shake for the ice cream?
examples.cn: 可以把奶昔換成雪糕吗？【milk shake：奶昔】

examples.en: Is it possible to exchange this shirt for a larger size?
examples.cn: 这件衬衫可以换一件大一点的吗？

pattern: Is there a better way to...？…

examples.en: Is there a better way to search for images on the Internet？
examples.cn: 在网上搜索图片有没有更好的办法？

examples.en: Is there a better way to send these books to my friend in Canada?
examples.cn: 有没有更好的办法把这些书寄给我在加拿大的朋友？

examples.en: Is there a better way to improve my pronunciation?
examples.cn: 有没有更好的办法来改善我的发音？

pattern: Is there any chance you could possibly...?

examples.en: Is there any chance you could possibly come to China？
examples.cn: 你有没有可能来中国？

examples.en: Is there any chance you could possibly change your schedule？
examples.cn: 你有没有可能改一下你的日程？

examples.en: Is there anything else that you don't understand?
examples.cn: 你还有什么不懂的地方吗？

examples.en: Is there anything else that I can do for you?
examples.cn: 我还可以帮你做点什么吗？

examples.en: It appears that the air is much cleaner this year.
examples.cn: 今年的空气似乎干净多了。

examples.en: It appears that great progress has been made in the IT industry.
examples.cn: 看来信息产业取得了巨大的进步。

examples.en: It depends on whether you are determined to do it or not.
examples.cn: 这取决于你是否决心要做这件事情。

examples.en: Itdepends on whether I do well on my exam or not.
examples.cn: 这取决于我考试考得好不好。

examples.en: It doesn't make sense to argue with him.
examples.cn: 和他争论没有任何意义。

examples.en: It doesn't make sense to spend so much money，
examples.cn: 花这么多钱没什么意义。 （第四章）

examples.en: It doesn't matter if you have made mistakes. Leam from your mistakes and you'll make progress.
examples.cn: 你有没有犯了错都没关系。从错误中学习，你就会进步。

examples.en: It doesn't matter whether you go to a famous university or not.
examples.cn: 你有没有上名牌大学并不重要。

examples.en: It goes without saying that China needs more English speakers.
examples.cn: 毋庸置疑，中国需要更多的人说英语。

examples.en: It goes without saying that women should have equal rights and opportunities with men.
examples.cn: 女性理应拥有和男性平等的权利和机会。

examples.en: It makes no difference to me whether you go or not.
